value.note: Impersonal verb: il pleut (attested).
il pleuvait; the participle pleuvant shows the same stem.
Irregular future stem, attested: il pleuvra; conditional il pleuvrait.
qu'il pleuve.
Irregular past participle plu (attested); the attested passé simple il plut uses the same stem.

evidence.notes: Impersonal defective 3rd-group verb used only in the il form; pleut, pleuvra, plu and plut are all attested in related_context.

value.note: je plonge, ils plongent, vous plongez.
-ger verb: e retained before -ons to keep /ʒ/ (source attests nous plongeons).
je plongeais; the participle plongeant shows the same change.
il plongea, with the extra -e- before the -a of the ending.
je plongerai; also conditional je plongerais.
que nous plongions; the singular subjunctive shares the plong- stem of the present.

evidence.notes: Regular 1st-group -ger verb; source attests nous plongeons, confirming the plong-/plonge- alternation.

value.note: je poche, ils pochent (culinary 'to poach').
nous pochons, vous pochez.
je pochais; the participle pochant is attested.
je pocherai.
que je poche.

evidence.notes: Fully regular 1st-group -er verb (past participle poché, present participle pochant).

value.note: je ponce, ils poncent, vous poncez; no cedilla before e/i.
-cer verb: cedilla before o to keep /s/ (source attests nous ponçons).
je ponçais; the participle ponçant shows the same change (attested).
je poncerai; also conditional je poncerais.
que nous poncions; the singular subjunctive shares the ponc- stem of the present.

evidence.notes: Regular 1st-group -cer verb; source attests nous ponçons, confirming the c/ç alternation.

value.note: je porte, ils portent (to carry; to wear).
nous portons, vous portez.
je portais; the participle portant is attested.
je porterai.
que je porte.

evidence.notes: Fully regular 1st-group -er verb (past participle porté, present participle portant).
